pins: All four probe outcome states coexist in one event and each carries exactly its own payload: success has data, skipped has a reason, timeout has nothing beyond status, error has an error message.
notes: Matches ProbeOutcome<T> in src/probes/types.ts and the outcomes produced by collectAll in src/probes/registry.ts.
A skipped probe is still reported; silence is not a substitute for an explicit skipped outcome.
